title: Broken public contract in a GPT-written change
intent: Make the quote response easier to read by returning the order total as a decimal string. The quote endpoint is public, and its response is documented in `docs/API.md`.
checks: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_api.py` ran in the repository: 3 passed.

problems.summary: quote no longer returns the documented integer field total_cents, so the consumer reports/export.py raises KeyError and external clients that parse the documented field break
